findings.title: A payment first seen already fully refunded at the provider settles the order as paid and fulfils it (receipt, file, a line to ship), while a voided one does not
findings.evidence: `v_charged := v_status in ('paid', 'refunded');` (line 1002) then step 8 runs finance.order_try_commit (stock down, entitlements, fulfilments 'preparing', receipt) and sets the order paid (1140-1145); only afterwards attempt_provider_alerts raises external_refund (1180). A voided payment is not charged (step 6 -> not_paid). tests/integration/payment.test.ts:1358-1361 pins it: apply with {status:'refunded', refunded: total} answers outcome 'paid'. Moyasar defines refunded as 'the merchant refunds a paid or captured payment' and voided as 'the merchant cancels a paid, authorized, or captured payment' (payment-status-reference, fetched 2026-10-07): both mean the money went back.
findings.impact: Precondition: the ledger has not seen the payment yet (webhook, callback and job failing for a while, e.g. a hosted Vault or functions outage) and Anas refunds it in Moyasar's dashboard (a buyer who called). When settlement resumes, the buyer is mailed «وصلتنا دفعتك وتم تأكيد طلبك», a digital file becomes downloadable (10 tokens a day, 3 uses each) and a physical line enters «للشحن»; the order shows no refund (the ledger's confirmed refunds are 0) until the owner records it. The owner sees an external_refund email, the home count and the reconciliation row; operations, who ship, see only a paid order (their home shows three counts, not externalRefunds). Stock taken by the commit never comes back by a refund.
findings.proposed_fix: In apply_verified_payment, before step 8: when v_status = 'refunded' and v_refunded >= v_amount, take the review branch (reason UNEXPECTED_STATUS, or a new REFUNDED_BEFORE_SETTLE added to the reason check) so nothing is fulfilled; when 0 < v_refunded < v_amount, commit as today and in the same transaction call finance.refund_dashboard(order, attempt, null, 0, v_refunded, ...) so the ledger equals the provider. Change payment.test.ts:1358 to expect 'review' for the full case and a provider_dashboard refund row for the partial one; amend contract section 2's 'charged' bullet.
findings.prior_overlap: lead:P08-CKPT-01 (confirmed; the lead's 'only signal is one email' is corrected: the owner also has the home count and the reconciliation row)

findings.title: The dispute decision «إيقاف الشحن» (fulfillment_stopped) stops nothing: the line stays in «للشحن», «تم الشحن» still ships it, and operations, who ship, cannot even see the dispute
findings.evidence: dispute_record checks that the named items are still 'preparing' and inserts the row; it writes nothing else for this decision (stats_disputes.sql:522-530, 533-551; contract: 'fulfillment_stopped ... is only recorded'). fulfillment_update reads no dispute: its refusals are ORDER_NOT_PAID, INVALID_ITEMS, BAD_TRANSITION, ITEM_REFUNDED and DEDICATION_NOT_DONE only (order_operations.sql:656-706). orders_list's to_ship and orders_alerts' toShip count every preparing line that is not fully refunded (243-247, 486-492). order_detail adds 'disputes' only when v_role = 'owner' (421-438). The form offers the decision as «إيقاف الشحن» with a list of lines to stop (admin-orders.ts:103-108, DisputeForm.tsx:204-228) and says nothing about it being a note; only docs/operations.md:1001-1002 says «(recorded only ...)». tests/integration/stats.test.ts:1020-1032 pins the record-only reading ("Nothing moved: the item is still being prepared and can still be shipped").
findings.impact: Precondition: a chargeback arrives while a physical or signed line is still being prepared, and someone other than the owner (an operations member) ships, or the owner forgets the note. The bank has taken the money back (against_seller), the owner records «إيقاف الشحن» believing the shipment is stopped, and the book still leaves: the line stays in the to-ship list and the shipping action accepts it. The loss is the goods on top of the charged-back payment.
findings.proposed_fix: Make the latest row of a reference enforce its decision: in fulfillment_update refuse p_state 'shipped' for an item named in a dispute whose latest row (max seq of its kind and reference) has decision 'fulfillment_stopped' (new code FULFILLMENT_STOPPED with its itemIds); leave such items out of to_ship and toShip; give order_detail's items a 'stopped' flag that operations see too. A follow-up row with another decision lifts it. Add tests to order-operations.test.ts (stopped item: shipping refused, not counted to ship; a follow-up 'none' lifts it) and stats.test.ts. If the orchestrator keeps the record-only reading instead, relabel the decision «تسجيل طلب إيقاف الشحن (للعلم فقط)», show it on the line to operations, and say in the form that shipping stays possible.
findings.prior_overlap: contract section 6 defines it as "only recorded" (P08-CONTRACT.md:378); no round file, audit or ISSUES entry discusses enforcing it (grep of fulfillment_stopped and stop/ship over artifacts/acceptance/P08 and PLANS finds only the contract)

findings.title: The payments_reconcile job has no health signal: a job that stops running leaves lost-webhook payments, uncertain creations and in-flight refunds unsettled with nothing on the owner home
findings.evidence: `const KNOWN_JOBS = ['email_outbox', 'site_build', 'media_sweep', 'backup'] as const` and STALE_JOB_MS has no payments entry; public.payments_kick (payment_core.sql:1653-1665) returns false without a run record when Vault lacks functions_url or jobs_secret; jobs.ts:23-48 records a run only when the function runs. Only the job marks UNVERIFIED (payment_attempt_checked, order_operations.sql:1124-1130), so unverifiedAttempts stays 0 when the job never runs. Not in PLANS/ISSUES.md I50/I51; docs/operations.md:1139-1149 ("Reading the payment job") documents the gap and gives two SQL lines to run by hand "when something sticks".
findings.impact: On the hosted project a missing Vault value, a pg_net failure or a function that errors every run means a buyer whose three prompts were all lost (webhook, invoice callback, return page) is never settled (money taken, the order expires, no receipt), an uncertain invoice creation is never adopted or abandoned, and a refund stays uncertain until the owner happens to press «أعد الفحص»; the owner home shows every other job's health and nothing for this one; of the reconciliation counts, unverifiedAttempts and exhaustedEvents are produced only by the job itself, so they stay at 0 exactly when it is not running (an uncertain refund does show, with nothing saying why it never settles).
findings.proposed_fix: Add 'payments_reconcile' to KNOWN_JOBS with a stale rule like email_outbox's: stale when a payment_attempts, payment_events or in-flight refunds row has had next_check_at <= now() - 10 minutes (a small finance.payments_due_since() like outbox_due_since); add the admin-home e2e assertion. Record it in ISSUES until it lands.
findings.prior_overlap: lead:P08-CKPT-07 (confirmed); round-12b.md:23 and :124 (uncovered, documented in operations.md with manual SQL, never ruled on or put in ISSUES)

findings.title: Shipping and refund mails carry an order link that is already dead for anything shipped or refunded more than 7 days after payment (every physical preorder bought more than a week before it ships)
findings.evidence: Every order mail ends with «صفحة طلبك (الرابط شخصي، لا تشاركه):» and a link built from the order's current token (email.ts:361-372, outbox.ts:177). The token's expiry is set to now()+7 days only at payment (payment_core.sql:1143,1151), recovery (delivery.sql:236,242), a file attached (delivery.sql:459) and order_resolve (order_operations.sql:967). fulfillment_update queues order_shipped (order_operations.sql:721-724) and finance.refund_succeed queues order_refunded (stats_disputes.sql:212-215) without touching access_token_expires_at; grep of every P08 migration for access_token_expires_at shows no other writer. order_access then answers NOT_FOUND for an expired token (delivery.sql:92-96) and OrderPage forgets the link and shows the recovery form (OrderPage.tsx:446-452).
findings.impact: A buyer whose book ships on day 8 or later (a signed copy with a dedication, any delay, and every physical preorder bought more than a week before its preorder_ships_on) clicks the order link in «شحنة جديدة من طلبك» and lands on «لم نجد هذا الطلب»/the recovery form instead of the order with its tracking; the same for a refund or a return refund made after day 7. The mail still holds the tracking number and amount, so nothing is lost, but the main post-sale journey looks broken and each such buyer must spend one of the 20 daily recovery mails.
findings.proposed_fix: In fulfillment_update, in the branch that queues order_shipped, and in finance.refund_succeed, in the paying-attempt branch that queues order_refunded, add `update finance.orders set access_token_expires_at = greatest(access_token_expires_at, now() + interval '7 days') where id = <order>` (the order row is already locked in both). Add to tests/integration/order-operations.test.ts: pay an order, set access_token_expires_at = now() - 1 minute, ship an item, assert order_access with the order's token answers ok; same in refunds.test.ts for a refund. Record the rule in contract section 4 (the list of renewals).
findings.prior_overlap: round-05.md:120 lists only the quota-delayed receipt/recovery link (mail held > 7 days); the shipped/refunded-after-7-days case is not in any round list or audit

findings.title: The invoice callback is throttled per caller IP, but every genuine callback comes from Moyasar's own servers: past 60 paid invoices an hour per Moyasar egress address the callback prompt is silently dropped
findings.evidence: payment_callback_begin: `if not finance.rate_limit_take('payment-callback:ip', p_ip_hash, 60, interval '1 hour') then return '{}'::jsonb; end if;` (1343-1345) runs before the invoice is looked up; the hash is of requestIp (cf-connecting-ip, else the last x-forwarded-for hop: rate-limit.ts:27-32) through payments.ts:485. The callback_url is POSTed by Moyasar, not by the buyer ('will get a POST request with the invoice object when the invoice is paid', contract section 2). The throttle was added at checkpoint 1 against floods (checkpoint-1-contract-audit.md:475-477); nobody weighed that the legitimate caller is a handful of provider addresses. No test sends callbacks from one address above the limit through the real function (round-03 uncovered).
findings.impact: On a busy hour (a launch, more than 60 paid invoices an hour from the same Moyasar address) every further callback answers 200 and settles nothing, so the callback stops being the second prompt. The webhook (not throttled) and the return page still settle each payment and the job backs them up, so no money is lost; the redundancy the contract counts on is gone exactly when traffic is highest.
findings.proposed_fix: Take the IP bucket only on a miss: look the invoice up first (provider_invoice_id = p_invoice_id, worth asking, fetched_at older than 5 s) and spend 'payment-callback:ip' only when no attempt matches, since a known invoice is already bounded by the 5-second fetched_at rule; or key the bucket on the invoice id. Add a payment.test.ts case: 61 callbacks for 61 distinct known invoices from one IP hash all return a check.
findings.proof_recipe: In the E02 sandbox run: pay two invoices and record the callback requests' source address (the function log's cf-connecting-ip, never the body); if both come from the same address the cap is shared by all buyers. Locally: select public.payment_callback_begin(<known invoice id>, repeat('a',64), 'test') 61 times for 61 different attempts worth asking; the wrong result today is '{}' from the 61st on.
findings.prior_overlap: round-03.md uncovered ('the callback throttle through the real functions'); checkpoint-1 E-SEC-06 introduced the throttle

findings.title: Work of the other mode disappears from every owner view: a mode_mismatch webhook is closed silently and a parked MODE_CHANGED attempt is in no list or alert, and its invoice is never cancelled
findings.evidence: payment_reconcile_claim parks other-mode attempts as `status = 'expired'`, `last_error = 'MODE_CHANGED'`, next_check_at null (1424-1428) without cancelling their invoices; the webhook closes an event of the other mode as 'mode_mismatch' (payments.ts:461) and the job likewise (payments.ts:636-638); finance.event_needs_person counts only outcome 'exhausted' (order_operations.sql:179) and reconciliation_list's reasons are UNCERTAIN, UNVERIFIED, PROVIDER_STATUS, EXTERNAL_REFUND only (order_operations.sql:553-561). Parked refunds do stay visible (they remain in flight).
findings.impact: Only after a switch of PAYMENTS_MODE while invoices of the old mode are open: after a rollback from live to test (an incident), a buyer still on a live invoice's page can pay it; the live webhook is closed mode_mismatch, the attempt is already 'expired', and the payment exists only in Moyasar's dashboard. Test-to-live leaves only test money behind, which does not matter.
findings.proposed_fix: When payment_reconcile_claim parks an attempt that has an invoice id, queue finance.owner_alert('mode_changed', <attemptId>, {attemptId, orderId}); add reason MODE_CHANGED to reconciliation_list for attempts with last_error = 'MODE_CHANGED' and list events with outcome 'mode_mismatch' from the last 30 days; say in docs/payments-runbook.md to cancel the old mode's open invoices before switching back.
findings.prior_overlap: lead:P08-CKPT-04 (confirmed, narrowed to the live-to-test direction); round-02.md uncovered (events of the other mode)

findings.title: Switching a preorder off (the documented moment the copies arrive) strands every order still holding a preorder reservation: its payment lands paid_needs_resolution and «إكمال الطلب» can never succeed, whatever the stock
findings.evidence: order_try_commit decides a line by its reservation's own flag: `if r.res_preorder then v_free := coalesce(r.preorder_capacity, 0) - finance.preorder_committed(r.variant_id) - …` (648-650), with r.preorder_capacity read from the variant now. The variant form nulls the capacity when preorder is switched off (src/admin/tables/variants.ts:97 `preorder_capacity: preorder ? … : null`), so v_free is 0 minus the committed preorder units and the line fails. order_resolve calls the same function (order_operations.sql:963) and answers STOCK_UNAVAILABLE, shown as «المخزون لا يكفي لعنصر في هذا الطلب؛ عدّل المخزون أو أعد مبلغ العنصر أولًا.» (admin-orders.ts:619): editing the stock cannot help. tests/integration/payment.test.ts:1664-1672 pins the needs_resolution outcome with stock 5 on hand. docs/operations.md:1083-1090 tells the owner to switch the preorder off when the copies arrive, without this warning.
findings.impact: Preorder is off at opening (Anas, Q05), so this bites only if it is used later: any buyer who was in checkout with a preorder line when Anas switched it off (holds last 20 minutes), and any late payment of an expired preorder hold, is charged, gets the 'under review' receipt, and the owner can only refund (or switch the preorder back on with a capacity), while the screen tells him to raise a stock that is already there.
findings.proposed_fix: In order_try_commit, when a reservation is flagged preorder but its variant is no longer a preorder (v.preorder false), decide the line by stock as an ordinary stocked line (and decrement it), since the copies have arrived and the owner's stock is net of the confirmed preorders only; keep the capacity rule while the variant is still a preorder. Change payment.test.ts:1664 accordingly and add an order_resolve case. Alternatively, at minimum, refuse saving preorder off while unpaid preorder holds exist and say so in docs/operations.md 'Preorders'.
findings.prior_overlap: contract section 4 ('this flag, not the variant's current one, decides at commit, at order_resolve and at restock'); payment.test.ts:1664 pins the commit side; no round discusses the resolve dead end

findings.title: dispute_record treats any call at an occupied seq as a repeat whatever it says, so a follow-up typed in a second tab is dropped and the owner is told «هذا السجل مسجّل من قبل؛ لم يتغير شيء.»
findings.evidence: `v_reply := finance.dispute_place(p_kind, p_provider_ref, p_follows + 1, p_environment); if v_reply is not null then return v_reply; end if;` (495-498): dispute_place (142-154) answers {ok:true, duplicate:true, dispute:<stored row>} for any row at that place, comparing no field. tests/integration/stats.test.ts:893-895 pins it ('Whatever the repeat says, it is the stored row that answers': a call with amount 9999, for_seller, decision none is a duplicate) and :949-951 (two follow-ups with amounts 10 and 20 at once: one is answered as a duplicate). src/lib/admin-money.ts:340 maps duplicate to DISPUTE_DUPLICATE «هذا السجل مسجّل من قبل؛ لم يتغير شيء.» and closes the form (done: true).
findings.impact: When two owners, or one owner in two tabs, record the next row of the same chargeback (the bank's decision, a for_seller reversal, a resolution), the second entry with different facts is silently discarded and its author is told it was already recorded; the statistics then count the latest stored row, not the one he typed. No money moves (disputes never refund), but the dispute ledger and its figures can disagree with what the owner believes he entered. Round 11b listed the stale-follows case as uncovered; nobody ruled on it.
findings.proposed_fix: Keep positional idempotency for a true repeat but compare the stored row with the call (target, amount, direction, occurred_on, decision, item_ids, resolution, and reason): equal is the duplicate it is today; different answers {ok:false, code:'SEQ_TAKEN'} (409 «سُجّل سطر آخر لهذا المرجع للتو؛ أعد فتح المرجع وراجع آخر سطر.») and writes nothing. Change stats.test.ts:893-895 and :949-951 to expect SEQ_TAKEN for the differing call, keep the identical-repeat assertions.
findings.prior_overlap: round-11b.md uncovered ('a follow-up whose follows fell behind a row recorded meanwhile ... answered as a duplicate ... No test')

findings.title: A file withdrawn by a dispute («سحب الملفات») can never be given back: a later follow-up «إبقاء الملفات» after the seller wins changes nothing and no action restores an entitlement
findings.evidence: Only entitlement_revoked acts (`if p_decision = 'entitlement_revoked' then perform finance.entitlements_revoke(v_order_id, v_items, 'dispute');`, 549-551); entitlement_kept and none are only recorded. finance.entitlements_revoke sets revoked_at and nothing ever clears it: paid_asset_set fills only `revoked_at is null` rows (delivery.sql:449-451), order_try_commit inserts entitlements `on conflict (order_item_id) do nothing` (payment_core.sql:699-705), and no SQL function or admin action sets revoked_at back to null (grep -rn 'revoked_at = null' supabase/migrations finds none). download_issue refuses a revoked entitlement (delivery.sql:311). tests/integration/stats.test.ts:1045-1054 pins "entitlement_kept and none only record" on a reference with no earlier revocation, which the fix below keeps true.
findings.impact: When the owner withdraws an e-book's files on a chargeback and the chargeback is then decided for the seller (the buyer's money comes back to Anas), the buyer who paid can never download again; the follow-up the form offers, «إبقاء الملفات», reads as giving the files back and does not. Fixing it needs hand-written SQL on the hosted database.
findings.proposed_fix: Let a follow-up row with decision entitlement_kept restore the named items' entitlements that this reference's earlier rows revoked (revoke_reason = 'dispute' and the item in an earlier row's item_ids): update finance.entitlements set revoked_at = null, revoke_reason = null where …, inside dispute_record, never for an entitlement revoked by a refund (finance.item_fully_refunded still true) or an order that is refunded. Test in stats.test.ts: revoke by a chargeback, follow-up for_seller with entitlement_kept, download_issue works again; a refunded item stays revoked.
findings.prior_overlap: none found (round-09 rulings cover recording and revocation, not restoring)

findings.title: payment_attempt_begin answers HOLD_EXPIRED before it answers the order's pending invoice, so a reload of the hold view in the hold's last 60 seconds ends the view and forgets the token while the invoice is still payable
findings.evidence: `if v_order.hold_expires_at < now() + interval '60 seconds' then return ... 'HOLD_EXPIRED'` (772-774) runs before the active-attempt select (779-806). HoldView.tsx:62 maps HOLD_EXPIRED to closed 'expired' and :100-101/:140 call onEnd(), which forgets the token and key (CheckoutForm.tsx:464).
